$comment: Explicit reuse permissions for third-party articles. Only URLs matched here are imported in full; everything else stays metadata-only (title + link). Never add an entry without written permission or a published licence that covers reuse. See scripts/content-import/authorizations.ts for the field reference.

format.url: Exact canonical article URL (use either url or urlPrefix, not both)
format.urlPrefix: Canonical URL prefix covered by the permission, e.g. a whole category

licence.name: Licence or permission name, e.g. CC BY 4.0 or 'Written permission'

format.grantedBy: Rights holder who granted the permission
format.grantedAt: ISO date the permission was granted or the licence was confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)
format.evidence: Where the permission is recorded: licence page URL or a path to the stored correspondence
format.attribution: Attribution text that must accompany any reuse
